senses.ex: Look at that cute little dog!
senses.exPt: Olha que cachorrinho fofo!

senses.def: someone who cannot stop using the internet
senses.ex: My brother is a real cyberaddict who never leaves his computer.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão é um verdadeiro viciado em internet que nunca sai do computador.

senses.def: a café where you can pay to use computers and the internet
senses.ex: I checked my email at a cybercafe near the hotel.
senses.exPt: Chequei meu e-mail num cibercafé perto do hotel.

senses.def: crime committed using computers or the internet
senses.ex: Cybercrime costs companies billions of dollars every year.
senses.exPt: O crime cibernético custa bilhões de dólares às empresas todo ano.

senses.def: an electronic toy pet that you have to feed and look after
senses.ex: Kids in the nineties loved feeding their cyberpets.
senses.exPt: As crianças dos anos noventa adoravam alimentar seus bichinhos virtuais.

senses.def: a school where students learn over the internet
senses.ex: She studies at a cyberschool, so she learns from home.
senses.exPt: Ela estuda numa escola virtual, então aprende em casa.

senses.def: the world of computers and the internet, seen as a place
senses.ex: Our personal data travels through cyberspace every day.
senses.exPt: Nossos dados pessoais circulam pelo ciberespaço todos os dias.

senses.def: a series of events that happen again and again in the same order
senses.ex: We learned about the life cycle of a butterfly.
senses.exPt: Aprendemos sobre o ciclo de vida de uma borboleta.

senses.def: to ride a bicycle
senses.ex: I cycle to work every day when it's sunny.
senses.exPt: Eu vou de bicicleta para o trabalho todo dia quando faz sol.

senses.def: the activity of riding a bike
senses.ex: I go cycling with my friends on Sundays.
senses.exPt: Eu ando de bicicleta com meus amigos aos domingos.

senses.def: the sport of racing bikes
senses.ex: My dad loves watching cycling on TV.
senses.exPt: Meu pai adora assistir ciclismo na TV.

senses.def: a person who rides a bicycle
senses.ex: Drivers should be careful when they pass a cyclist.
senses.exPt: Os motoristas devem tomar cuidado ao ultrapassar um ciclista.

senses.def: a person who believes people are selfish and things will go badly
senses.ex: Call me a cynic, but I don't think he'll keep his promise.
senses.exPt: Pode me chamar de cético, mas não acho que ele vai cumprir a promessa.

senses.def: believing that people only care about themselves and nothing will improve
senses.ex: Many young people are cynical about politics.
senses.exPt: Muitos jovens são descrentes em relação à política.

senses.def: in a way that shows you believe people act only for themselves
senses.ex: He smiled cynically when I mentioned the government's promise.
senses.exPt: Ele sorriu com cinismo quando mencionei a promessa do governo.

senses.def: the belief that people are selfish and not honest
senses.ex: There is growing cynicism about politicians and their promises.
senses.exPt: Há uma descrença cada vez maior nos políticos e nas suas promessas.
